query:
INSERT INTO candidate_profile(candidate_id, crawl_id, url, mismatched_at)
            VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?)
            ON CONFLICT (candidate_id, url)
            DO UPDATE SET mismatched_at = coalesce(
                max(mismatched_at, excluded.mismatched_at),
                mismatched_at,
                excluded.mismatched_at
            )
